prek_hooks.name: 🚫 claude-all · No AWS-reserved Lambda env vars
prek_hooks.description: Flags aws_lambda_function environment variables that AWS reserves (AWS_REGION, AWS_LAMBDA_*, _HANDLER, ...) and rejects at apply time.

prek_hooks.name: 📏 claude-all · Lambda env under 4KB
prek_hooks.description: Statically estimates each aws_lambda_function's Environment.Variables JSON size and flags any over the 4096-byte AWS cap.

prek_hooks.name: 🧊 claude-all · Terraform owns ECS container definitions
prek_hooks.description: Flags aws_ecs_task_definition lifecycle ignore_changes covering container_definitions (or all), which freezes the container env block.
